Hi, I’m Gavin Boss — an Applied Business Analytics student at Boston University passionate about analytics.

I have been an Intelligence analyst for roughly 8 years but am looking to transition out of the military world and into the private sector and want to expand into business analytics. I have been attending online courses through Boston University while maintaining a full-time job at USCENTCOM as an All-Source Analyst.

My goals include advancing my analytical toolkit outside of government contracting with the DOD and developing expertise in business analysis.
